evals.prompt: I need to put together a 5-slide pitch deck for a meeting next week with the CRO of a mid-size regional bank. They're currently using legacy on-prem risk systems and we want to show them why VOR Stream is a better fit. Can you create the pptx?
evals.expected_output: A .pptx file with 5 slides using FRG brand colors (black/white/lime #93C30B), correct typography (serif headings, sans-serif body), proper FRG messaging about cloud-native SaaS differentiation, and content tailored to an Economic Buyer persona (CRO).

assertions.text: Uses FRG lime green (#93C30B or close variant) somewhere in the presentation
Content includes language targeting economic buyers: mentions ROI, cost savings, efficiency, compliance, risk reduction, or total cost of ownership
References 'VOR Stream' by name at least once
Mentions cloud-native, SaaS, or cloud-based as a differentiator
Uses a serif font (Chronicle, Libre Baskerville, Georgia, or Times) for at least some headings

evals.prompt: We're presenting at a risk management conference next month and I need a polished 8-slide presentation that introduces FRG as a company — who we are, what we do, our products, and why we're different. Make it look really professional. Save it as a pptx.
evals.expected_output: A .pptx file with ~8 slides covering FRG overview, mission/vision, VOR product suite, differentiation, and contact. Should use FRG brand colors, photography style guidance, approved messaging, and proper typographic hierarchy.

assertions.text: Uses FRG lime green (#93C30B or close variant) somewhere in the presentation
Mentions at least 3 VOR products by name
Includes at least one approved FRG tagline: 'Analyze Risk Differently' or 'Build. Run. Illuminate.'
Covers all three areas: company overview/mission, product portfolio, and differentiation/why FRG

evals.prompt: Draft a one-page sales leave-behind document (Word doc) for VOR Performance specifically targeting risk analysts. Something they can take away after a demo meeting that summarizes the key benefits and features.
evals.expected_output: A .docx file styled with FRG branding (black/white/lime for VOR materials, no magenta), content tailored to End User persona (analysts), and focused on VOR Performance features.

assertions.text: Uses VOR-appropriate colors (black/white/lime/green) and does NOT use magenta/maroon accents
Content is specifically about VOR Performance (not generic VOR or VOR Stream)
Content speaks to analysts/end users — mentions ease of use, insights, visualization, speed, or analytics
Mentions performance analytics, production reports, or performance attribution
Includes FRG company identification (company name, website frgrisk.com, or logo reference)
